adaptation_recommendation.text: Adapt choice and dosage of antithrombotic agent and secondary prevention medications to renal function, co-medications, comorbidities, frailty, cognitive function, and specific contraindications.

frail_older_patients.text: For frail older patients with comorbidities, individualize interventional and pharmacological treatments after careful evaluation of risks and benefits (holistic approach).

invasive_strategy_in_cancer.text: An invasive strategy is recommended in cancer patients presenting with high-risk ACS with expected life survival ≥6 months.

temporary_interruption_of_cancer_therapy.text: Temporary interruption of cancer therapy is recommended in patients in whom the cancer therapy is suspected to be a contributing cause of ACS.

aspirin.text: Aspirin is not recommended in cancer patients with a platelet count <10,000/μL.

clopidogrel.text: Clopidogrel is not recommended in cancer patients with a platelet count <30,000/μL.

prasugrel_ticagrelor.text: In ACS patients with cancer and <50,000/μL platelet count, prasugrel or ticagrelor are not recommended.

cardiac_rehabilitation.text: All ACS patients should participate in a medically supervised, structured, comprehensive, multidisciplinary exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation and prevention programme.

healthy_lifestyle.text: ACS patients should adopt a healthy lifestyle, including stopping all smoking, a healthy (Mediterranean) diet, alcohol restriction, regular aerobic physical activity and resistance exercise, and reduced sedentary time.

lipid_lowering_therapy.text: High-dose statin therapy is recommended to be initiated or continued as early as possible, regardless of initial LDL-C values.
